method: Native outer mangrove-symbol front of the western Poyan peninsula, reread independently on source crop [4800,5800,5300,6600]. Smooth interpolation between source readings; 2–4 native-pixel reading uncertainty and unmeasured external datum. The three bottom/west coverage legs are entirely inside retained G16 land and cannot become coast. The uninked internal clearing has no qualified water symbol and is not promoted to a water polygon.
